summary: Alphabet Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a ¥576.9 billion underwritten public offering of Japanese yen-denominated senior notes under its existing shelf registration. The offering comprised four tranches: ¥135.5B of 1.965% notes due 2029, ¥200.5B of 2.412% notes due 2031, ¥123.2B of 2.822% notes due 2033, and ¥117.7B of 2.970% notes due 2036. The notes were issued under a 2016 indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation, as it involves no change in control, restructuring, or other special event. It is an ordinary shelf takedown.
